clientId.title: Nuheat Client ID
clientId.description: Optional advanced override. Leave blank to use the built-in default client ID.

clientSecret.title: Nuheat Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Optional advanced override. Leave blank to use the built-in default client secret.

redirectUri.title: Nuheat Redirect URI
redirectUri.description: Optional advanced override for OAuth redirect URI.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Optional allow-list of thermostats to expose. Leave empty to auto-discover all thermostats on the account.

autoPopulateAwayModeSwitches.title: Auto populate Away Mode switches for all available groups

exposeScheduleSwitches.title: Expose per-thermostat schedule switches
exposeScheduleSwitches.description: Creates a switch for each thermostat that reflects whether its schedule is active and can be turned on to resume the configured schedule.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Optional allow-list of groups to expose as away-mode switches. Leave empty unless you want to add specific groups manually.

holdLength.title: Hold Length (in minutes)
holdLength.description: If set to 0, set point changes will hold until the next scheduled event. If set to 1440 (default), set point changes will be permanent. Set to any value in between for a timed hold.

enableNotifications.title: Enable Nuheat notifications (SignalR)
enableNotifications.description: Disable this to use REST polling only while troubleshooting notification or API issues.
